skin: Neutral skin: no brand guide yet; run /ck:brand-guide to add one.

variants.label: A
variants.name: List first
variants.rationale: The turn is a checklist; the player reads down.
variants.tradeoff: Less room for the card art.
variants.satisfies: Requirement 1: every rule a player needs during a turn is printed on a card in play.

variants.label: B
variants.name: Card first
variants.rationale: The active card fills the screen; the checklist is a strip.
variants.tradeoff: The strip hides steps on small screens.
variants.satisfies: Requirement 1: every rule a player needs during a turn is printed on a card in play.
